why: A clear, calm droplet already reads as native Liquid Glass and adds no chrome of its own, so the pet fits the app as it is.

veto.quote: custom chrome where a system control belongs; clutter.
veto.why: A pet moving in the corner while you paint is clutter on the canvas and custom chrome where the app should stay quiet.

style: Clear glass with a soft inner glow, smooth calm motion, and no hard outlines.
making: Worry: separately drawn pets may vary in glass clarity and glow; check every sheet against the droplet's clear, calm reference before it ships.
